controllers.recognised: Recognised: {name}. Set up from its known layout, nothing to assign.
controllers.checkIt: Check it in half a minute: move each stick and flip each switch. Every bar must follow its control; Reverse or Set again a line that does not, then Fly.
controllers.report: Something reads wrong? Send a report (B) saying which control lit up: the layout is then fixed for every pilot.
controllers.control.flightModeSwitch: Flight mode switch N / S / M
controllers.note.djiThrottle: The throttle stick springs back to the middle as DJI ships it, which is half throttle. For FPV flying stop the spring with the F1 / F2 screws behind the stick (DJI manual, Manual mode).
controllers.note.djiArm: Arm: throttle down, press start/stop (the next press disarms).
controllers.note.djiMode: Flight mode switch: N = Angle, S = Horizon, M = Acro.
controllers.edgetx.why: EdgeTX radio: its channels are your model's own setup, so the wizard asks for each stick once.
controllers.useKnown: Recognised: {name}. Its known setup (Mode 2 sticks at full range, flight mode switch N / S / M = Angle / Horizon / Acro) can replace this saved one.
